## Summary of Architectural Proposal
Provide a high-level summary of the proposed architectural modification.

## Problem Statement & Motivation

## Affected Contracts & Schemas

## Compatibility & Migration Assessment
- Does this introduce a breaking contract change?
- How will backward compatibility be preserved?

## Draft ADR Reference
Link to draft ADR or outline the decision rationale.
